subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should this PR's public `deferred` cron status and SDK lifecycle surface be accepted as the permanent contract for yielded-parent handoff, or should the branch be split to avoid that public surface for now?
rationale: The code path looks directionally sound, but the PR expands public protocol, CLI, UI, hook, and SDK contracts; automation cannot decide that product/API shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
options.body: Ask for redacted Discord progress/status proof and explicit upgrade/API acceptance before merge.

options.title: Split Public Surface
options.body: Keep the internal yielded-parent repair path but defer or remove the public `deferred` status and SDK additions until the contract is designed separately.

options.title: Accept Contract Risk
options.body: Merge on source review, CI, and cron proof alone while intentionally accepting downstream client/plugin and Discord proof risk.

recommendation.title: Require Proof And Contract Signoff
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Discord progress/status proof and explicit upgrade/API acceptance before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a broad public contract choice spanning cron, Discord, Gateway, SDK, CLI, UI, and docs, and steipete is the strongest available routing owner from recent adjacent merge history.
